name: Frozen Track A single-video efficiency, given inputs
scene_selection: First manifest scene of each K, selected without timing results; equal scene weight
batch: One video; frame methods batch1, ATB retains its frozen two overlapping groups per internal call
core: Prepared host-side model inputs through complete frozen method pipeline to float host RGB, including method-required layering/inpainting and internal transfers. Existing finite/control instrumentation retained; this is pipeline wall time, not isolated CUDA kernel time.
e2e: E2E-given-inputs: input decode/read, geometry/control adaptation, full method pipeline, CPU output transfer and clamp/round RGB8. Excludes model loading, output file writing, video encoding, metrics, unavailable GT generation and external depth estimation.
drbokeh: Synthetic GT union alpha + LaMa reconstruction, frozen gamma2.2/lens71/grid2d; not DAVIS Full-public
deeplens: Frozen external-geometry TF1.15 CPU / single SR / aperture saturation, not DAVIS native DepthNet
time: perf_counter with GPU synchronize at clip/core boundaries; nested Core within E2E in the same repeat; no production jobs in parallel
rng: Separate timing process, initial seed0 (BokehDiff42), continuous stream across warmup/repeats; does not change saved quality outputs or their RNG states
peak_memory: PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks plus nvidia-smi device memory sampled every0.2s on exclusive GPU; sampled total includes CuPy/context but is not an exact instantaneous maximum. CPU VRAM is N/A.
aggregation: Per-scene mean/std over5 repeats, then equal mean over4 scenes; FPS=25/mean E2E seconds; preserve all raw repeats and by-K values
